intended_use.summary: Use current primary RAG evaluation research only for the narrow principles that retrieval and generation require separate diagnostic metrics, retrieved context should be focused as well as complete, and retrieval improvements can trade useful information for noise. Runbook Sentinel will implement project-authored exact-ID metrics over its frozen synthetic corpus. No external code, dataset, model, package, prompt, service, or paper bytes are imported.
